# MDL511 · `table-sections-lost`

<!-- Generated by tools/gendocs from internal/rules: do not edit. -->

This mydumper version ignores every table section, masking included.

| | |
|---|---|
| Family | tables |
| Default severity | error |
| Fix | — |
| Design references | F17 |
| Proven on real mydumper by | [`mdl511-table-sections-lost`](../../e2e/scenarios/mdl511-table-sections-lost.txtar) |

## Why

mydumper v0.21.2-2 and v0.21.2-3 read the table sections before creating the tables that store them: GLib refuses every insertion (a `GLib-CRITICAL` line on stderr) and the dump goes on without any per-table setting. Masked columns are dumped in plaintext; `where`, `limit` and the other table keys do not apply. myloader is not affected. Upgrade mydumper (v0.21.2-4 fixes it), or pin another version. Reported as a warning for sections without masked columns.

## Example

With mydumper v0.21.2-2:

❌ Before:

```ini
[mydumper]
threads=2
[`app`.`users`]
`email`=random_string
[`app`.`orders`]
where=id > 10
[`app`.`users`]
limit=5
```

```text
3:2-3:15 error MDL511[table-sections-lost] mydumper v0.21.2-2 ignores this table section: it reads table sections before creating the tables that store them
  = Its masked columns are dumped in plaintext, and its other settings do not apply.
5:2-5:16 warning MDL511[table-sections-lost] mydumper v0.21.2-2 ignores this table section: it reads table sections before creating the tables that store them
  = None of its settings apply to the dump; myloader still reads them.
```

## Configuration

Enabled by default. To change its severity or turn it off:

```yaml
rules:
  severity:
    MDL511: warning   # or error, info, off
```

To accept one occurrence, put `# mydumper-lint: disable-next-line=MDL511` on the line above it.
